records.Japanese: ちょっと、あんた
records.current_English: Hey, you.

records.Japanese: うん？
records.current_English: Hm?

records.Japanese:
これをあんたにやるから
好きに使ってくれ！
records.current_English: Take this. Use it however you like!

records.Japanese: は？
records.current_English: Huh?

records.Japanese:
あっ！　いやがった！
待ちやがれ！
records.current_English: There you are! Stop right there!

records.Japanese: じゃあな！
records.current_English: See ya!

records.Japanese: 待ちやがれ！
records.current_English: Stop right there!

records.Japanese: ちょ、ちょっと待って…！
records.current_English: W-wait a minute!

records.Japanese: 何やってるんですか、提督？
records.current_English: What are you doing, Admiral?

records.Japanese: なんか、無理矢理渡されちゃった
records.current_English: Someone shoved this into my hands.

records.Japanese: 何なんです？
records.current_English: What is it?

records.Japanese: 本みたいだけど
records.current_English: It looks like a book.

records.Japanese:
どれどれ
『ガラスの製法辞典』…
records.current_English:
Let's see. 
 A Dictionary of Glassmaking...

records.Japanese:
ふーん
もらっておけばいいじゃないですか
records.current_English: Hmm. Why not keep it?

records.Japanese: でも…
records.current_English: But...

records.Japanese:
くれるってもんは
もらっておけばいいんですよ
records.current_English:
If someone's giving it to you, you 
 might as well take it.

records.Japanese: そうだ、後で見せてくださいね
records.current_English:
Oh, and let me take a look 
 at it later, will you?

records.Japanese: …それが目的だったんだね
records.current_English: ...So that's what you were after.

records.Japanese:
ていとくぅ～
おいら、欲しい武器があるんだ～
records.current_English: Admiral... There's a weapon I want.

records.Japanese: えっ？
records.current_English: Huh?

records.Japanese:
あのねぇ、おいらも強くなりたいから
武器が欲しいんだぁ～
records.current_English:
You know, I want to get stronger 
 too. That's why I want a weapon.

records.Japanese:
食べ物じゃない物が欲しいなんて
珍しいね。何て名前の武器？
records.current_English:
You don't usually ask for anything 
 but food. What's the weapon called?

records.Japanese: 『ミノタウロスの斧』！
records.current_English: The Minotaur's Axe!

records.Japanese:
何だか、強そうな名前だね
で、どこにあるの？
records.current_English:
Sounds pretty powerful.
 So where is it?

records.Japanese:
さあ…。昔
ミノタウロスがこの島にいたんだって
おいらが知ってるのはそれだけだよ
records.current_English:
I dunno. I heard the Minotaur
 was on this island a long time ago.
 That's all I know.

records.Japanese:
手がかりが少ないなあ…
まあ、気が向いたら探してみるよ
records.current_English:
That's not much to go on...
 Well, maybe I'll look
 for it if I feel like it.

records.Japanese: やったー！
records.current_English: Hooray!

records.Japanese: あくまで、気が向いたらだからね
records.current_English: Only if I feel like it, okay?

records.Japanese: でも、やったー！
records.current_English: Still, hooray!

records.Japanese:
あのさ…君にあげるとは
約束してないからね
records.current_English:
You know... I never promised I'd 
 give it to you.

records.Japanese: えー
records.current_English: Aww.

records.Japanese: そこまでだ
records.current_English: That's far enough.

records.Japanese:
うっ、何をする！
放しやがれ！
records.current_English: Gah! What are you doing?! Let me go!

records.Japanese:
うっ、何をする！　放せ！
あ！　あなたは…！！
records.current_English:
Gah! What are you doing?! Let me 
 go! Oh! You...!!

records.Japanese: 何をなさるか！？
records.current_English: What is the meaning of this?!

records.Japanese:
えええっ！　クリフォードさん？！
どういうことよ？
records.current_English:
What?! Mr. Clifford?!
 What's going on?!

records.Japanese:
目障りだった奴らが
ようやく、くたばってくれた
records.current_English: Those pests finally dropped dead.

records.Japanese:
FI
おまえにもいろいろと協力して
もらったな。とりあえず礼を言う
records.current_English:
FI, you've helped me
 in so many ways. First, let me 
 thank you for that.

records.Japanese:
その上、こういうことを頼むのは
大変、心苦しいんだが…
records.current_English:
It pains me to ask this after all
 you've done for me, but...

records.Japanese:
今まで集めた『覇者の証』を譲って
ほしい。譲ってくれれば
こいつの命は保障する
records.current_English:
I want all the Proofs of Conquest
 you've collected.
 Hand them over, and I guarantee
 your companion's life.

records.Japanese:
どういうつもり！？
人質を取るなんて卑怯よ！
records.current_English:
What are you doing?! Taking
 a hostage is cowardly!

records.Japanese:
何なんだよ、これは！？
おまえらしくないじゃねえか！
records.current_English:
What's going on here?! 
 This isn't like you!

records.Japanese:
あたしたち『同盟』を結んでいた間柄
なのよ？お互いに協力して
やってきたんじゃない！
records.current_English:
We were allies! Didn't we work 
 together and help each other?!

records.Japanese: それは過去のことだ
records.current_English: That is over.

records.Japanese:
そもそも、あたしたち『同盟』を
結んでるのよ？同盟相手に剣を向ける
とはいい度胸ね！
records.current_English:
We are allies! Drawing a sword on
 your ally takes nerve!

records.Japanese: 今をもって解消だ
records.current_English: As of now, it's over.

records.Japanese: まさか、最初からそのつもりで…？
records.current_English:
You mean... You planned
 this from the start?

records.Japanese: 悪いな。そういうことだ
records.current_English: Sorry. That's exactly right.

records.Japanese: わしらは、全員でだまされたんじゃな…
records.current_English: We were all deceived...

records.Japanese: ひどい…
records.current_English: That's horrible...

records.Japanese: 俺も『覇者の証』には興味があった
records.current_English: I was interested in the Proofs, too.

records.Japanese:
だが、俺には王室に与えられた
スペイン監視という使命がある
そう自由に動くわけにはいかない
records.current_English:
But the Crown gave me a mission: 
 watch Spain. I can't move about
 as freely as I'd like.

records.Japanese:
となれば、誰かに『覇者の証』を
集めてもらうしかない
君は打ってつけの存在だったよ
records.current_English:
That meant someone else
 had to collect the Proofs for me.
 You were the perfect choice.

records.Japanese:
そんな…人間のすることじゃないわ
誰かを利用するなんて！
records.current_English:
That is inhuman! Using someone 
 like that!

records.Japanese:
このあたしを、そこまで利用しつくす
とはね…。クリフォード…！
許せない！
records.current_English:
You used me for everything 
 I was worth... Clifford! 
 I can't forgive you!

records.Japanese:
同盟を結んだときの君のセリフ
覚えてるよ。良心がとがめなかったと
思うか？　でも
俺にはこうするしかなかった
records.current_English:
I remember what you said 
 when we became allies. You think 
 my conscience was clear? 
 But I had no choice.

records.Japanese: 何が良心だよ！　何でこんな…
records.current_English: Conscience?! Why do this?

records.Japanese:
FI
俺の夢は、たぶん君と同じだ
分かってくれ
records.current_English:
FI, I think we share the same 
 dream. Please try to understand.

records.Japanese:
あんたの夢があたしと同じ？
笑わせるんじゃないわよ！
records.current_English:
Your dream is the same as mine?
 Don't make me laugh!

records.Japanese:
ここまできて、もったいつける気か
君だって『覇者の証』を手に入れて
世界中の海を制覇しようって
魂胆だろう？
records.current_English:
Why hide it at this point? You want
 the Proofs to conquer every sea
 in the world, just like me.

records.Japanese: 違う！　あたしは違うわ！
records.current_English: No! That's not what I want!

records.Japanese:
あたしは世界中の困っている人を…
いい…あんたには言わない
あたしの夢は、あんたには絶対に
分かってもらえないと思う
records.current_English:
There are people in need all 
 over the world, and I... No. 
 I won't tell you. You'd never
 understand my dream.

records.Japanese:
俺の夢と同じじゃないのか
それは残念だ。だが
『覇者の証』は譲ってもらうよ
records.current_English:
So we don't share the same dream?
 That's a shame. But I'll still 
 be taking the Proofs.

records.Japanese:
君の仲間を殺すのは本意じゃない
俺もそこまで悪人にはなりたく
ないんだ
な…素直に譲ってくれないか
records.current_English:
I don't want to kill your friend.
 I'd rather not be
 that kind of villain.
 Come on. Just hand them over.

records.Japanese: …分かったわ
records.current_English: ...Okay.

records.Japanese:
FI！
ダメだよ！　渡さないで！！
records.current_English: FI! No! Don't hand them over!

records.Japanese:
だって！
カミルの命のほうが大事だもん！
records.current_English: But Camille's life matters more!

records.Japanese:
いい判断だ
ありがたく受け取らせてもらおう
records.current_English:
A wise choice. I'll gladly 
 accept them.

records.Japanese: ターレスの紙地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Thales' Paper Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: 狩猟神ウルの弓矢を奪われました！
records.current_English: Ullr's Bow was stolen!

records.Japanese: ペリアンドロスの石地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Periander's Stone Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: アクスム王の金印を奪われました！
records.current_English: Aksum Gold Seal was stolen!

records.Japanese: ソロンの葉地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Solon's Leaf Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: リグ＝ヴェーダを奪われました！
records.current_English: Rigveda was stolen!

records.Japanese: クレオブロスの布地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Cleobulus' Cloth Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: カンビセスの冠を奪われました！
records.current_English: Cambyses' Crown was stolen!

records.Japanese: ケイロンの竹地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Chiron's Bamboo Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: 始皇帝の長信宮燈を奪われました！
records.current_English: Qin Palace Lamp was stolen!

records.Japanese: ビアスの貨幣地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Bias' Coin Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: クディリの永久なる護符を奪われました！
records.current_English:
Kediri's Eternal Talisman
 was stolen!

records.Japanese: ピッタコスの刃地図を奪われました！
records.current_English: Pittacus' Blade Map was stolen!

records.Japanese: 水晶のどくろを奪われました！
records.current_English: Crystal Skull was stolen!
